title: Composed supervisory control: Good/reject batch statistics with reject lockout -> Inspection-window reject lockout

inputs.name: A_BatchTarget
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Total parts in a batch

inputs.name: B_Rejected
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Current inspected item rejected

inputs.name: B_WindowSize
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Items per inspection window

inputs.name: B_RejectLimit
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Rejects allowed in one window

outputs.name: A_QualityFault
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Reject count exceeded limit

outputs.name: B_WindowCount
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Items in current window

outputs.name: B_RejectCount
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Rejects in current window

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: A_BatchTarget and A_RejectLimit remain positive and constant during a test.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: B_WindowSize is at least 1 and B_RejectLimit is non-negative.
Subsystem B: B_Rejected is sampled only on a rising B_Inspected edge.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A good-part rising edge increments only A_GoodCount; a reject-part rising edge increments only A_RejectCount.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Simultaneous good and reject edges shall count one reject and no good part.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_GoodPart) AND rose(A_RejectPart) AND !A_Reset) -> (A_RejectCount=prev(A_RejectCount)+1 AND A_GoodCount=prev(A_GoodCount)))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_BatchDone shall be TRUE when A_GoodCount plus A_RejectCount reaches A_BatchTarget.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_QualityFault shall latch when A_RejectCount reaches A_RejectLimit and remain set until A_Reset.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear both counts, A_BatchDone, and A_QualityFault.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Each rising B_Inspected edge shall add one to B_WindowCount and, when B_Rejected is TRUE, one to B_RejectCount.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (rose(B_Inspected) AND !B_Reset AND !B_LockedOut -> update_window_counts))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Completing B_WindowSize items shall pulse B_WindowComplete for one scan and then start a new zeroed window.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: If rejects in the completed window exceed B_RejectLimit, B_LockedOut shall latch TRUE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: No new items shall be counted while B_LockedOut.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_LockedOut AND !B_Reset -> (B_WindowCount=prev(B_WindowCount) AND B_RejectCount=prev(B_RejectCount))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear counts, B_WindowComplete, and B_LockedOut.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Reset -> (B_WindowCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND !B_WindowComplete AND !B_LockedOut)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_BatchDone shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND B_WindowCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND NOT B_LockedOut AND NOT B_WindowComplete)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (B_WindowCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND NOT B_LockedOut AND NOT B_WindowComplete))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
